This indicates that Thioridazine may influence Htr6 through its role in the antipsychotic pathway, possibly by modulating the activity of its target compounds. The evidence is supported by the shared classification of Thioridazine and its analogs as organonitrogen heterocyclic compounds and antipsychotics, suggesting a common pharmacological mechanism.
